params.caption: 🎮 Final Fantasy XIV players hold in-game funerals for The Primals' bassist Final Fantasy XIV players are gathering inside the game to mourn the bassist of The Primals, the MMO's official band. Virtual funerals and tribute meetups are taking place on servers worldwide, celebrating his legacy in the game's music. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 00:59 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: IGN 🕯️ React to pay respect · 💬 Share your favorite Primals track below #FFXIV #FinalFantasy #GamingNews
